subject: Remove dead code around should_expand_db (#12767)
reason: The change is a pure refactor with no behavior change. In src/rdb.c it removes error-handling branches after dbExpand(..., try_expand=0) calls that were unreachable dead code: dbExpand only returns C_ERR on paths guarded by `try_expand && result == DICT_ERR`, and with try_expand=0 it always returns C_OK (dictExpand allocates via zmalloc, which aborts on OOM rather than failing). In src/db.c it only rewords two log message strings. No command reply, RDB loading outcome, replication, or persistence path can differ between the parent and the change, so there is nothing a scenario could observe.
